question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS stddev_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
  WHERE "loss_rate_%" IS NOT NULL
),
items AS (
  SELECT 
    "loss_rate_%",
    (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) AS avg_lr,
    (SELECT stddev_loss_rate FROM stats) AS sd_lr
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
  WHERE "loss_rate_%" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(avg_lr, 4) AS avg_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" < avg_lr - sd_lr THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_one_stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" >= avg_lr - sd_lr AND "loss_rate_%" <= avg_lr + sd_lr THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_one_stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" > avg_lr + sd_lr THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_one_stddev
FROM items
GROUP BY avg_lr, sd_lr;
